mission: Prove that continuous environmental fields plus resource competition, mutation, dispersal, developmental programs and history can generate reusable plant species whose ecological strategies and visible forms emerge without hardcoded biome or tree/bush/grass placement classes.

nearest_checkpoint.name: Environmental Causality Baseline
nearest_checkpoint.goal: Prove deterministic continuous environment truth and a causal resource/cost response of one fixed plant genome before introducing evolution or developmental complexity.

steps.name: Environment Contracts + Deterministic Fixture
steps.output: Headless EXP-V0 with stable environment queries, control samples and environment hash.

steps.name: Single-Plant Resource Model
steps.output: Headless EXP-V1 with explicit resource income, costs, bounded biomass and limiting-factor evidence.

steps.name: Diagnostic Visual Lab + Controlled Trait Probes
steps.output: Presentation-only heatmap lab and controlled sensitivity probes sharing the accepted S1/S2 truth model.

steps.name: Determinism, Sensitivity and Failure Classification
steps.output: Replay acceptance runner, sensitivity evidence and explicit failure matrix.

steps.name: P1A Acceptance + Evolution Decision
steps.output: ACCEPTED or classified FAIL decision and handoff to ECO.P1B Local Adaptation Proof plus ECO.PH0 Development Trait Contract.

acceptance_gate: environment query is deterministic and seam-safe
environment truth is independent from camera LOD and presentation
one fixed genome produces favourable marginal and unsustainable zones
resource and cost breakdown explains local outcome
at least one real trait trade-off is demonstrated
same seed and revision produce identical environment and simulation hashes
controlled trait probes move niches in explainable directions
visual and headless evidence share one truth model
nearest_checkpoint.after_pass: Open ECO.P1B Local Adaptation Proof and ECO.PH0 Development Trait Contract in parallel research lanes; evolution remains based on accepted resource truth.
nearest_checkpoint.after_fail: Do not add evolution or developmental complexity; classify and repair ENVIRONMENT_MODEL, RESOURCE_MODEL, TRADEOFF_MODEL, NUMERICAL_STABILITY, DIAGNOSTIC_GAP or PERFORMANCE_MODEL.

developmental_phenotype_track.name: Plant Development and Phenotype
developmental_phenotype_track.goal: Turn inherited plant genomes into deterministic development programs, environment-dependent phenotypes, seed-carried heredity and representation-safe visual forms without canonical tree/bush/grass classes.
developmental_phenotype_track.pipeline: Genome + Environment + Age + History + IndividualSeed -> DevelopmentState -> ShootGraph/RootGraph -> Phenotype -> Representation

steps.name: Development Trait Contract
steps.output: DevelopmentTraits, DevelopmentState, GrowthGraph and IndividualSeed contracts; explicit inherited-vs-derived boundaries.
gate: no TREE/BUSH/GRASS canonical type
development traits do not change accepted EnvironmentSample truth
renderer does not participate in genome/resource hashes

steps.name: Deterministic GrowthGraph Skeleton Lab
steps.output: One shared developmental generator creates line/skeleton plants from traits and IndividualSeed without mesh.
gate: same genome + environment + individual seed produces identical graph hash
apical dominance branch angle internode and branching probes create continuous morphology changes
tree-like and shrub-like forms emerge without separate generators

steps.name: Environment-Coupled Development and Phenotypic Plasticity
steps.output: Phototropism/gravitropism and resource-aware development produce explainable phenotype differences for one unchanged genome.
gate: one genome yields distinct phenotypes across environments
genome checksum remains unchanged across plastic responses
environment truth remains independent from GrowthGraph

steps.name: Morphology-to-Resource Coupling
converges_before: ECO.P1C Strategy Competition Proof final acceptance
steps.output: Height, leaf area/density, branching/crown and root architecture gain explicit benefits and costs in resource competition.
gate: no bigger-is-always-better morphology
at least three morphology traits demonstrate measurable trade-offs
selection can act on morphology through resource consequences rather than cosmetic score

steps.name: Seed Development Lifecycle
steps.output: Parent genome -> SeedGenomeEnvelope -> mutation/inheritance -> germination -> juvenile -> adult -> seeds.
gate: seed transports heredity and stored energy not prebuilt mesh
individual seed deterministically initializes development variation
lineage provenance survives dispersal and germination

steps.name: Procedural Visual Materialization
steps.output: GrowthGraph becomes branch mesh plus parameterized leaf/flower/fruit representation with LOD.
gate: renderer asset pack and tessellation changes do not change ecology/genome hashes
evolved developmental traits are visually distinguishable
GrowthGraph can project to multiple representation levels

steps.name: Promoted Individual Persistence
steps.output: Only interacted/promoted individuals persist damage pruning growth and DevelopmentState/GrowthGraph deltas through canonical future persistence adapters.
gate: ordinary individuals remain reproducible derived representations
promotion and demotion conserve population/ecological state
ECO does not create a duplicate production persistence foundation

convergence_rules: PH0/PH1 may begin only after P1A acceptance so developmental complexity cannot hide errors in baseline resource causality
PH1 may run in parallel with P1B
PH3 must converge before final strategy-competition acceptance if morphology is part of the selected strategy space
PH4 must converge before dispersal/biogeography treats seeds as inheritance carriers
PH5 extends P3 EXP-V9; mesh and leaf assets remain representation only
PH6 waits for future canonical persistence/authority adapters

waves.name: Plant Adaptation Proof
waves.goal: Prove deterministic environment response, local adaptation and coexistence of multiple resource-paying strategies, including morphology once PH3 converges.
gate: environment queries are deterministic and seam-safe
resource response is causal
mutation creates regionally distinct trait distributions
at least three persistent strategies coexist on one heterogeneous fixture
no hardcoded biome species roles
same seed produces identical result hash
different seeds preserve specialization as a phenomenon
if developmental morphology participates in selection then PH3 morphology resource trade-offs are proven before final strategy-competition acceptance

waves.name: Ecological History Proof
waves.goal: Prove succession, disturbance memory, dispersal-limited ranges and lineage divergence.
gate: succession emerges without scripted succession states
disturbance history remains visible in population composition
suitable habitat does not create species without migration
at least one stable lineage split preserves common ancestry
seed/dispersal heredity preserves genome and lineage provenance when PH4 is active

waves.name: Portable Ecology Proof
waves.goal: Convert expensive evolution results into reusable catalog and representation-safe runtime candidates, including deterministic developmental phenotype materialization.
gate: SpeciesCatalog serialization is deterministic
new fixtures can be populated without replaying long evolution
SpeciesCatalog carries development traits/recipe sufficient to reproduce phenotype candidates
phenotype presentation does not affect ecology hash
population representation transitions conserve ecological state
player disturbance feeds generic ecological rules rather than scripted biome replacement

future_program_stages: ECO8 Developmental Phenotype and Visual Materialization
runtime_promotion_requirements: ECO.P3 SpeciesCatalog bake proven before production integration
developmental phenotype contracts remain representation-safe and do not make GrowthGraph planet-wide canonical truth
PC0 branch registration from then-current main
harness checkpoint permits runtime frontier creation
authority and persistence design reviewed separately
